# Browser Bridge

> **v0.13.1 · 100% Local · Zero-Port Secure · Native-Rust FAST (<0.2–1.1 ms Pipe IPC & Zero-Collision Multi-Browser Routing) · Self-Evolving (Structured CSS/DOM Diagnostics & Reversible `browser_patch`, Verified Transactional Installer, Quality-Constrained `SiteLearner` v2, `waitForDomQuiet`, `browser_media` & HLS/fMP4 `browser_download`, `browser_batch`, 24 Timestamped `routines/*.json` Playbooks & WebMCP)** — MCP server, Native Messaging host, cross-browser extension (Edge, Chrome, Brave, Firefox), and zero-dependency Python SDK for your own signed-in browser tabs.

## One-Prompt AI Agent Installation & Upgrade

- [Agent Installation Playbook (docs/INSTALL.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dcluomax/browser-bridge/main/docs/INSTALL.md): Step-by-step zero-build SHA-256-verified installer instructions for GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and Codex.
- [Verified Packages, Transactional Install & Safe Updates (docs/INSTALLATION.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dcluomax/browser-bridge/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md): Deterministic ZIP/XPI verification, compare-and-swap rollback/pinning, dedicated Firefox dev launcher, and opt-in Windows idle-safe updates.
- [Structured Debugging & Reversible Patches (docs/DEBUGGING.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dcluomax/browser-bridge/main/docs/DEBUGGING.md): Computed styles, cascade context, box models, hit testing, semantic DOM baselines, temporary patches, sanitized HAR 1.2, and performance samples.
- [Upgrade Notes v0.10.x / v0.11.x / v0.12.0 -> v0.13.1 (docs/UPGRADE.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dcluomax/browser-bridge/main/docs/UPGRADE.md): Structured live-tab diagnostics, transactional packaging, zero-collision sub-millisecond multi-browser routing, native HLS/fMP4 media download, `SiteLearner` v2, and 24 timestamped `routines/*.json` playbooks.
- [Versioning & Site-Optimization Policy (docs/VERSIONING.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dcluomax/browser-bridge/main/docs/VERSIONING.md): Website optimization JSON updates always increment the 3rd SemVer digit (`PATCH`, `0.10.Z`) with refreshed ISO-8601 UTC `verifiedAt` and `updatedAt` timestamps.
- [Changelog & Benchmarks (CHANGELOG.md)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dcluomax/browser-bridge/main/CHANGELOG.md): Full release history and network-excluded speedup metrics across all 24 built-in websites.
